run_dense_entity_linking: run BLINK dense entity linking on test mentions using biencoder and crossencoder models
run_interactive_entity_linking: run BLINK in interactive mode to link entities from user input text
load_models: load biencoder and crossencoder models along with candidate entity catalogues and encodings
annotate_mentions: annotate input sentences with named entity mentions using the NER model
load_candidates: load candidate entity catalogues with optional FAISS flat or HNSW index for retrieval
